description: Scaffold the routines-app scenario using the standard Vrooli react-vite template (API + UI + CLI + service.json). Acceptance: scenario can be started via vrooli scenario start routines-app, the UI loads, the CLI is callable, and the API exposes a minimum GET /routines endpoint returning an empty list. No real routine logic yet — this is the infra gate for the v0 curated content to land on.
name: routines-app-scenario-init
title: Initialize Routines-App Scenario From React-Vite Template
